Replace sequence with sequences within convention

replace_sequences.Rd

The original peptide sequences are replaced with the peptide convention - described in the get_sequence_bonds function. Moreover the maximal uptake value is calculated based on the number of exchangeable bonds according to the convention. Function from prepHaDeX.

Usage

replace_sequences(dat, threshold = 0.3)

Arguments

dat

data with sequences to be replaced

Examples

replace_sequences(alpha_dat)
